content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves a collision between the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain, which is the chain-against-chain setting the rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter; the defender's chain is footed but rests on the woman-route inference.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"by footing, never verse by verse: one reading bars using 'does not name Joseph' as a defect in a footed chain; the other permits noting the missing name as a chain-level support observation.","why":"The judge treats the challenger's footed chain as underdetermined partly because it does not name Joseph, which is the word-for-word/stating-verse test K-C retires for chain collisions."}
